subject: Consumption & peak TPS alignment for Hosted API (recap + next steps)
messages:
From: PrIyOm Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Grant <alex@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Consumption & peak TPS (hosted) — quick confirmations

Alex — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying asks so we can put together an initial hosted API pricing band and a MUTUAL ACTION PLAN for procurement.

TL;DR from our side: we need a plausible monthly token range, expected peak TPS (requests/s) during spikes, rough split of workload types (generation vs embeddings), and a target $/1M tokens you’d like us to aim for in a commercial proposal.

Recap of what we heard on the call:
- Primary workload: in-product conversational assistant + occasional embedding indexes for search.
- Typical prompt lengths: short system+user prompts (~80–180 tokens) with generated outputs averaging ~220 tokens.
- Spike pattern: brief high-traffic windows tied to marketing pushes (we discussed a potential 10–15x spike for ~20–30 minutes).

Requests for you (can reply inline):
1) Expected monthly token consumption: can you give a low / expected / high range (e.g., 10M / 40M / 80M)?
2) Peak TPS during your largest spike: both requests/s and estimated tokens/s if possible.
3) Percentage split: generation vs embeddings vs re-ranking (ballpark %).
4) Target budget or target $/1M tokens you have in mind for a hosted offering (helps us map to commit bands).

Next steps from Redwood if numbers align:
- We share a first-draft pricing band and a 30-day pilot plan (dedicated credit + burst headroom).
- Draft MAP + SOW for procurement to review.

I attached a one-page mutual action plan template to speed procurement review. If easier, we can run a quick 20-minute follow-up tomorrow to confirm numbers and scope.

Thanks — Pr

--
PrIyOm Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147
From: Alex Grant <alex@lumenai.com>
To: PrIyOm Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: LumenAI Procurement <procurement@lumenai.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Consumption & peak TPS (hosted) — quick confirmations

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the clear recap. Answers below inline and a few clarifying notes from our side.

1) Monthly token consumption (low / expected / high): 25M / 42M / 90M. Our baseline for Q4 forecast is ~42M but we budget for heavy campaigns that push us toward the high end.
2) Peak TPS: we saw ~280 req/s during our largest internal load test (that was short, ~10 minutes). For planning, assume safe spike capacity at ~350 req/s to avoid throttling. In tokens/s terms during spike windows we estimate ~40k–80k tokens/s (varies with prompt length).
3) Workload split: generation ~68%, embeddings ~22%, re-ranking ~10%. Embedding calls are generally smaller but frequent during index builds.
4) Target $/1M tokens: procurement preference is to land in the $6–$9 per 1M tokens range at scale; for a first-year commitment they’re willing to consider $8/1M as an anchor if we can guarantee burst headroom and sensible SLOs.

Other constraints:
- 95th percentile latency target: <350ms ideally for text generation (we can accept up to 450ms for longer generations).
- Security: standard SOC 2 + IP segregation during pilot (we can share procurement contact for a short questionnaire).

If you can convert this into a proposal with an initial 30-day pilot + pricing bands and a proposed $/1M for the 0–50M and 50M+ buckets, we’ll circulate to procurement.

Best — Alex
Alex Grant
Head of Platform, LumenAI
alex@lumenai.com | +1 (617) 555-0202
From: PrIyOm Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Grant <alex@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T14:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Consumption & peak TPS (hosted) — quick confirmations

Alex — perfect, this is exactly what we needed. A couple of quick notes and an initial commercial sketch so procurement has something concrete to react to.

Commercial sketch (hosted API, monthly commit bands) — ballpark for discussion only:
- 0–50M tokens/month: $11 per 1M tokens
- 50–200M tokens/month: $8 per 1M tokens
- >200M tokens/month: custom enterprise band (volume discounts + committed throughput SLA)

Pilot offer:
- 30-day pilot with $10k credit applied to usage + temporary burst headroom to 400 req/s (for the pilot window) to validate the 350 req/s spike tolerance.
- Standard SOC 2 evidence + short questionnaire — we’ll loop in our security team; procurement can send the questionnaire to security@redwood.ai.

Operational notes / follow-ups:
- To size quotas and throttles we need your estimate of concurrent requests during spikes (e.g., 50–100 concurrent open streams vs short stateless requests).
- Any hard SLO for tail latency (95th) you want to include in the pilot? We can commit to an internal target of 95th < 350ms for typical generation shapes, with a fallback to a slightly cheaper variant if latency target cannot be met under sustained heavy load.

I attached the Mutual Action Plan and a simple pricing sheet so procurement can see the math. If you like, Marissa (cc’d) can pick up scheduling and run the pilot kickoff next week.

Would you be available for a 20-minute sync on Wednesday 10/22 at 10am PT to sign off on MAP and pilot dates?

Thanks — Pr

--
PrIyOm Das

priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

3) DocuSign: if procurement is comfortable, I can send a MAP + pilot SOW for signature (no long-term commitment until after pilot).
Please let me know who at procurement should get the DocuSign envelope (I can include the security questionnaire link in the same envelope). HubSpot link here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4821
